The hash-object matches HEAD version, meaning the file content that git sees is the ORIGINAL, but sed showed modified. Wait, hash-object on disk returns cb3c... which equals HEAD:... So git thinks disk content is unmodified. But sed showed modified content.

This is contradictory unless sed read a different file than git hash-object. Hmm, but same path.

But hash-object says disk matches HEAD. Yet sed shows modified. Let me directly cat and hash in same command.
